prompt: Create a vertically stacked two-panel comparison image on a 3:4 canvas. The top panel is a realistic close-up photograph of a fair-skinned left hand held palm-facing inward in bright outdoor sunlight, fingers gently curled to show exactly 5 short natural fingernails: thumb at upper left, index, middle, ring, and pinky on the right. The nails are rounded-square, translucent pale pink, glossy, with subtle fine glitter sparkle. Skin has warm highlights and natural texture. Background is an out-of-focus garden with dark green foliage bokeh and a sandy beige ground strip, strong natural shadows, shallow depth of field. The bottom panel is a minimalist watercolor-and-ink illustration inspired by the same hand pose, centered on an off-white textured paper background with lots of empty space. Draw exactly 5 simplified fingernails matching the curled hand pose, using thin gray-brown line art, soft peach skin washes, and delicate pale pink nail shimmer. Add exactly 3 muted sage-green abstract brush patches around the hand: 2 small patches on the left and 1 patch on the lower right. Add exactly 2 tiny sparkle icons to the right of the illustrated hand. Below the illustration, centered, add small widely spaced serif text reading little spark, a short thin horizontal divider line, and the year 2024. Overall mood is cute, soft, airy, handmade, and aesthetic; no extra objects, no watermark, no additional text. Use sheer pale pink glitter for both the photo and illustration, warm off-white for the lower panel, and blurred green garden foliage in sunlight for the upper panel.
